qwen/qwen3.8-27b.description: Qwen 3.8 27B (fp8) — the only chat-capable model in KosCompute's roster; the other 6 ids returned by /v1/models are Whisper transcription and TTS models (endpoint_kind audio/tts), not chat. Confirmed via unauthenticated GET https://api.koscompute.com/v1/models (2026-09-28, HTTP 200): context_length 262144 (modality_context_lengths.text), 131072 for image input; max_output_length/max_output 32768; pricing input $0.35 / output $2.20 per MTok, cached input $0.09 (the response's own precomputed input/output/cache_read fields, matching prompt/completion/input_cache_read per-token rates); supported_features [tool_calling, json_mode, structured_outputs, reasoning]; supported_endpoints [/v1/chat/completions, /v1/responses, /v1/messages]; input_modalities [text, image] with vision.max_pixels 1048576. model_info reports reasoning:true, extended_thinking:true, thinking_default:true, max_thinking_tokens:8192, supported_reasoning_efforts [none, low, medium, xhigh]. Docs corroborate generically for the chat-completions surface: api.koscompute.com/docs/guides/tool-calling/ (tools array, tool_choice auto|none|required|named, results read from choices[0].message.tool_calls), /docs/guides/structured-output/ (response_format json_object and json_schema, 'Unsupported models return a 400 capability error' for models lacking json_mode/structured_outputs — this model advertises both), and /docs/guides/streaming/ (stream:true, text/event-stream, data: [DONE]). No live capability probe was run (credential-free onboarding, no API key) — see evidence.liveMatrix: null.

errorRules.message: Invalid KosCompute API key. Check {apiKeyEnvVar}. See {setupUrl} for what KosCompute's docs publish on authentication — the vendor documents 401 as 'missing, invalid, expired, inactive, or conflicting credentials' but gives no example error body or code string.
KosCompute model '{model}' not found. Pick a current id from an unauthenticated GET https://api.koscompute.com/v1/models.
KosCompute per-key concurrency limit exceeded for '{model}'. Wait for an in-flight request to finish, or reduce parallel requests, before retrying.

instructions: 1. KosCompute publishes no public signup, dashboard, or key-management page as of 2026-09-28 — the docs' quickstart (this URL) assumes you already hold a key and only shows how to use one, via `export KOSCOMPUTE_API_KEY="your-api-key"`; the site's only 'Start building' call-to-action also points here, not to a signup form

2. The docs reference an account 'balance' (/docs/overview/authentication/: 'Authentication success does not guarantee model access, remaining account balance, or available capacity') but publish no pricing, free-tier, or top-up page, so billing policy could not be confirmed from public sources — treat this entry's `no-free-tier` as the conservative default in the absence of any documented free allocation, not a confirmed vendor policy
3. Once you have a key (provisioned out of band), set {apiKeyEnvVar} in your .env file
4. Sanity-check connectivity first with an unauthenticated GET https://api.koscompute.com/v1/models (no key needed) before spending a real chat request
setup.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint at https://api.koscompute.com/v1, described by the vendor as EU-hosted inference (docs: 'EU-hosted, OpenAI-compatible inference for chat, reasoning, vision, speech recognition, and speech synthesis'); also exposes Responses-API and Anthropic-Messages-compatible surfaces for the same chat model. No public signup or key-management page is published, and billing policy is unconfirmed.
